notes: Per-thread account UI: an AccountControl beside the model picker (composer and plan Start) shows the account the thread spends from (nickname, else the email's local part; Auto before the first spawn) and opens the account list; the list now describes a thread (where its account comes from, an Auto row that clears the thread pin, a check on the account in use, a pin on the explicit pin) and a row click pins the thread through session.account.pin; the usage footer shows the active thread's account and its bars, and the global pin only without a thread. session.create takes accountPin (never inherited by a child). The switch path is gone: accounts.switch, the store's switch, AccountsService.switch and the activate dep; temp-code no longer moves Aliax's global pin or signs the CLIs in.
